description.p: FortiVPN GUI is a Linux desktop VPN client for FortiGate gateways. It uses the system openfortivpn binary and stores OpenFortiGUI-compatible INI profiles under ~/.fortivpngui/.

The Flatpak UI runs sandboxed; openfortivpn, ppp, and sudo must be available on the host. Install the included sudoers drop-in on the host (see package documentation) so passwordless openfortivpn works.
Fix the FortiGate OTP dialog only appearing after Stop; Request new OTP reconnects when openfortivpn has exited; Flatpak packaging.
Tauri 2 / Rust desktop shell rewrite with .deb, .rpm, AppImage, and Flatpak packaging.
